UndergroundRivalBeforeText:
Hold it!

I saw you, so I
tailed you.

I don't need you
underfoot while I

take care of TEAM
ROCKET.

…Wait a second.
You beat me be- fore, didn't you?

That was just a
fluke.

But I repay my
debts!
UndergroundRivalWinText:
…Why…
Why do I lose?

I've assembled the
toughest #MON.

I didn't ease up
on the gas.

So why do I lose?
UndergroundRivalAfterText:
…I don't under-
stand…

Is what that LANCE
guy said true?

That I don't treat
#MON properly?

Love…

Trust…

Are they really
what I lack?

Are they keeping
me from winning?

I… I just don't
understand.

But it's not going
to end here.

Not now. Not
because of this.

I won't give up my
dream of becoming

the world's best
#MON trainer!
UndergroundRivalLossText:
Humph. This is my
real power, wimp.

I'll make TEAM
ROCKET history.

And I'm going to
grind that LANCE under my heels.
GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntrances_:
I was challenged
to a battle down- stairs.

It's rough down
there. You'd better be careful.

There are some
shops downstairs…

But there are
also trainers.

I'm scared to go
down there.
GruntM11SeenText:
Open one shutter,
another closes.

Bet you can't get
where you want!
GruntM11BeatenText:
Drat! I was sunk
by indecision!
GruntM11AfterBattleText:
I'm confused too…
The switch on the

end is the one to
press first, but…
GruntM25SeenText:
Kwahaha!

Confounded by the
shutters, are we?

I'll let you in on
a secret if you can beat me!
GruntM25AfterBattleText:
All right. A hint!

Change the order
of switching.

That'll change the
ways the shutters open and close.
BurglarDuncanAfterBattleText:
Steal and sell!
That's basic in crime, kid!
BurglarEddieSeenText:
They ditched this
project before they finished.

I'm searching for
leftover loot.
BurglarEddieAfterBattleText:
UNDERGROUND WARE-
HOUSE?

What do you want
to go there for?

There's nothing
down there.
GruntM13SeenText:
I don't care if
you're lost.

You show up here,
you're nothing but a victim!
GruntM13BeatenText:
Urk! Yeah, think
you're cool, huh?
GruntM13AfterBattleText:
You must have ice
in your veins to dis TEAM ROCKET.
GruntF3SeenText:
Are you lost? No,
you can't be.

You don't have
that scared look.

I'll give you
something to be scared about!
GruntF3AfterBattleText:
Go wherever you'd
like! Get lost! See if I care!
